title: Moths recorded at four types of street lamp
bodyMd: Ecologist Iris Sandoval set an automatic moth trap beside street lamps of four types in the same town. Because the lamp types were not all installed in equal numbers, the traps ran for different numbers of nights, so Sandoval recorded both the total catch and the catch per night.

data.caption: Nights surveyed, total moths captured, moths captured per night and number of moth species recorded at each of four street-lamp types (Sandoval).

accessibilityText: A four-row table of moth-trapping results. The columns are lamp type, nights surveyed, total moths captured, moths captured per night, and moth species recorded. Low-pressure sodium: 25 nights, 500 moths in total, 20 per night, 11 species. Warm white LED: 20 nights, 640 moths in total, 32 per night, 14 species. Mercury vapour: 10 nights, 900 moths in total, 90 per night, 23 species. Cool white LED: 20 nights, 1,100 moths in total, 55 per night, 19 species. Each per-night figure is the total divided by the nights surveyed.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The ecologist, the town and every figure are invented; the counts were chosen so that each per-night rate is a whole number and so that the ranking by total differs from the ranking by rate.
